description: Ballarat Bus Shelters is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Ballarat. This dataset describes the type and location of bus shelters located in Ballarat. The information was collected as the shelters were constructed. The intended use of the information is to inform the public of the locations of Ballarat's bus shelters. This dataset is typically updated monthly on an automated schedule. Coverage: City of Ballarat. The portal files it under the publisher City of Ballarat. Its tags are bus, bus-stop, ptv, public-transport, shelter. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, JSON, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
